sections.heading: Version 1.0 (2018) Scope
sections.content: Version 1.0 applies to factories emitting more than 80 tons of CO2 per year and requires annual emissions reports submitted by March 31.

sections.heading: Version 2.0 (2021) Update
sections.content: Version 2.0 lowers the reporting threshold to 60 tons per year and changes the reporting deadline to February 28.

sections.heading: Version 1.0 (2019) Limits
sections.content: Version 1.0 sets a maximum nitrate concentration of 12 mg/L in discharge water and requires quarterly sampling.

sections.heading: Version 1.1 (2022) Revision
sections.content: Version 1.1 tightens nitrate concentration to 10 mg/L and adds mandatory monthly sampling for facilities near protected wetlands.

sections.heading: Version 1.0 (2017) Work Hours
sections.content: Construction noise above 65 dB is allowed from 7:00 to 19:00 on weekdays and from 9:00 to 14:00 on Saturdays.

sections.heading: Version 2.0 (2023) Work Hours
sections.content: Version 2.0 keeps weekday hours unchanged but prohibits noisy construction work on Saturdays in residential zones.

sections.heading: Version 1.0 (2020) Allergen Rules
sections.content: Packaged foods must declare 8 major allergens and list ingredients in descending weight order.

sections.heading: Version 1.2 (2024) Allergen Expansion
sections.content: Version 1.2 expands mandatory allergen disclosure to 11 allergens, adding sesame, mustard, and lupin.

sections.heading: Version 1.0 (2016) Retention Period
sections.content: Public agencies may retain user activity logs for up to 5 years and must provide deletion on verified request.

sections.heading: Version 2.0 (2022) Retention Period
sections.content: Version 2.0 reduces maximum retention of user activity logs to 3 years and requires annual deletion audits.

sections.heading: Version 1.0 (2018) Baseline
sections.content: New commercial buildings over 5,000 square meters must meet an energy use intensity target of 160 kWh/m2/year.

sections.heading: Version 2.0 (2025) Baseline
sections.content: Version 2.0 applies to buildings over 3,000 square meters and lowers the energy use intensity target to 130 kWh/m2/year.
